message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 8 Wild cards (4 Wild, 4 Wild Draw Four). | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck.
2. Deal 7 cards to each player.
3. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On your turn you may:
• **Play** one card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard card, or a Wild card.
• **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot or choose not to play. If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Skip (+S)** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse (+R)** – Reverses play direction (in a 2‑player game, acts like a Skip).
• **Wild (+W)** – You choose the new active color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+WD4)** – You choose the new active color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. They receive points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players: numbered cards count as their face value, Draw Two/Skip/Reverse = 20 points each, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Winning the Game** | The first player to reach 500 points (or the agreed target) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – Knowing what’s out can help you plan your next move. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save them for when you’re stuck or to force a tough draw on opponents. 3. **Watch for “Draw Four” challenges** – If you suspect a player is bluffing, you can challenge; if they’re right, you draw four; if they’re wrong, you draw six. 4. **Manage your hand** – Try to keep a mix of colors so you’re never forced to draw. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
